Venomous_Scorpion_Stinger_Tail.description: The venomous scorpion stinger tail, a fearsome appendage of arachnid origin, pulses with dark magic and toxic venom, enhancing its bearer's strength and agility while granting the abilities to unleash a poison cloud and inflict bleeding wounds.

Silk_Spinning_Spinneret_Tail.description: This slender, iridescent tail, a marvel of arachnid ingenuity, is tipped with spinnerets capable of weaving fine, sticky silk threads that enhance the agility and stealth of its bearer, granting them the grace to move undetected and the strength to ensnare foes with a single, swift flick.

Acid_Spraying_Bombardier_Tail.description: Equipped with an appendage of nightmares, this insectoid tail secretes a vile, corrosive acid capable of disintegrating flesh and bone, its toxic payload ready to unleash a choking poison cloud at a moment's notice.

Luminescent_Firefly_Abdomen_Tail.description: This ethereal firefly abdomen, glowing with an otherworldly light, trails behind like a radiant beacon, enhancing the wearer's charm and awareness while granting the abilities to emit light and lure unsuspecting creatures into its magical aura.

Barbed_Wasp_Stinger_Tail.description: A writhing, venomous appendage that pulses with dark energy, the barbed wasp stinger tail is a deadly, toxic extension that grants its bearer unparalleled speed and agility, allowing them to strike with blinding precision and unleash a choking cloud of poisonous gas.

Heavy_Beetle_Club_Tail.description: The Heavy Beetle Club Tail is a formidable appendage, its thick, armored segments densely packed with muscle and chitin, capable of delivering devastating blows that can knock down even the most stalwart opponents and sunder the toughest of armors.

Feathered_Moth_Tail.description: Adorned with delicate, iridescent wings that shimmer in the dim light, the Feathered_Moth_Tail grants its bearer heightened perception and an innate connection to arcane energies, enabling them to detect magical auras and float effortlessly through the air.

Ghost_Mantis_Ghost_Abdomen.description: The spectral abdomen of the Ghost Mantis undulates with a ghostly luminescence, its ethereal presence granting it unparalleled stealth and the ability to blend into the shadows, while also bestowing upon it an otherworldly sight that pierces through the veil of the physical realm.

Camouflaging_Stick_Insect_Tail.description: This prehensile tail, a marvel of natural engineering, is adapted from the slender body of a stick insect, allowing its bearer to blend seamlessly into the environment while enhancing their ability to move with catlike grace and climb sheer surfaces with ease.

Subterranean_Mole_Cricket_Spade_Tail.description: The Subterranean Mole Cricket's Spade Tail is a powerful, shovel-like appendage, perfectly adapted for burrowing through the dense soil of underground tunnels, granting the bearer immense strength and resilience, while also bestowing the skills to resist knockback and cause knockdown to foes.
